about_the_game:
Inspired by survival horror classics like 'Slender Man', IT LURKS throws you into the depths of a rotting sewer system with something that hunts you in the dark, able to hear even the faintest breath. Scavenge for scarce supplies to stay alive, all while searching for vital data cards and uploading them to the surface for analysis.

  • Survival Under Pressure - Hunt for vital data tapes within a sprawling sewer system. With a severely limited inventory, every expedition demands tough choices and multiple trips, each one pulling you further into the horrors that lurk.

  • Limited Inventory - Carry only what’s essential, every slot matters. Every choice could be a matter of life or death.

  • Lethal Encounters  - Silence is survival. It doesn’t chase, it waits.

  • Immersive VHS Horror - Explore a decaying world brought to life with retro visuals and sound design that heighten the unease.

You are part of a specialised response team sent to investigate a mysterious infestation deep underground. The mission is considered too dangerous for full deployment, so you are sent in alone with minimal gear... only a dim headlamp to cut through the dark. There are no maps, no backup, and no certainty about what you will face. The tools you need to survive and complete your mission are scattered throughout the tunnels, left behind by crews who never returned.

As you press deeper, you discover fragments of the facility’s archive stored on fragile data tapes. These must be collected and uploaded to the surface, but not all of them are safe. Some of the tapes are corrupted, their data twisted and dangerous. Solving puzzles and unlocking sealed systems will lead you to the truth, but choosing the wrong tapes could doom the mission.

And all the while, something stirs in the shadows. Watching. Waiting.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains mild violence, blood, and horror themes. It includes disturbing imagery, psychological horror, gore, and intense scenes that may be unsettling to some players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: IT LURKS is a survival horror game set in an infested sewer. Hunted by a relentless presence, you must recover scattered data tapes and piece together a way to transmit them topside. Every step brings you closer to escape… or into its grasp.
